mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate above 4.0% signals monetary tightening coinciding with labor stress, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In strong GDP growth regimes (quarterly GDP growth above 2.0%), accelerating corporate earnings support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this effect vanishes during low-growth periods.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% q/q, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1,300,000 units per month signals residential sector contraction that precedes consumer spending slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high labor market slack regimes (unemployment rate above 4.5%), reduced consumer spending and corporate investment lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days, reversing when unemployment falls below 4.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, persistent price pressures prompt restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
